case_number: 2025 INSC 307; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SLP (Crl.) No.15156 OF 2024)

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Bail cancellation in dowry death case; Sections 304B, 498A IPC; post-mortem reveals strangulation, ante-mortem injuries; dowry demands for motorcycle and car; father-in-law and mother-in-law implicated in cruelty and homicide; bail cancelled for Accused Nos.2 and 3; bail upheld for sisters-in-law (Accused Nos.4 and 5) due to personal circumstances; High Court's mechanical bail grant criticized; social impact of dowry deaths emphasized; partial bail cancellation for ends of justice.
final_judgment: Bail cancelled for Accused Nos.2 and 3 (father-in-law and mother-in-law); bail upheld for Accused Nos.4 and 5 (sisters-in-law); appeal partly allowed.
